# BrandKev

> BrandKev (brandkev.com) offers free, no-sign-up color and font tools for brands — a color palette generator, color code converter, color codes chart, font pairing tool and HEX-to-CMYK print guide. BrandKev is also a digital marketing and brand creative studio in Dubai, UAE.

All tools run in the browser, are free for personal and commercial use, and don't upload user data.

## Free tools

- [Color Palette Generator](https://www.brandkev.com/color-palette-generator): Generate beautiful 3–8 color palettes in one click. Lock colors you love, pick a harmony, export to CSS, Tailwind or PNG.
- [Color Code Converter](https://www.brandkev.com/color-converter): Convert any color between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK. Get tints, shades, harmonies and a contrast check.
- [Color Codes Library](https://www.brandkev.com/color-codes): All 148 named web colors with HEX and RGB codes, grouped by color. Search, copy and convert in a click.
- [Font Pairing Tool](https://www.brandkev.com/font-pairing): Hand-picked Google Font pairings for logos, websites and decks — including Arabic + English pairs for the UAE.
- [HEX to CMYK & Pantone Guide](https://www.brandkev.com/cmyk-pantone-guide): Turn screen colors into print-ready CMYK values and learn how to find the right Pantone match for your brand.

## Useful deep links

- Palette by colors: https://www.brandkev.com/color-palette-generator?colors=003FFC-4D7CFF-F4F1EA-FFB547-0B132B (hyphen-separated HEX codes without #)
- Convert a color: https://www.brandkev.com/color-converter?hex=003FFC (HEX without #)
